about: LIVE1 (2026-11-07, docs/ai-ranking-2026-11-05/fixes/LIVE1.md): labelled set for two of the Link Builder's prospect rules (the outreach kit, v5/code/_outreach_kit.js), the ones the first live AI ranking run caught refusing good lists. `gambling`: OK.sellSignals flags a page as gambling / CBD / essay-mill topics (label true = a careful human would refuse it for that reason). `competitor`: OK.sellsSame calls the prospect a competing site (label true = it is one). Pages are synthetic (.example hosts) and keep only the shape that decides the rule; the two live cases are modelled on the 2026-11-06 production rows (a software firm's list whose quote form offers 'Fantasy & Betting' as an industry; a LinkedIn article that ranked #3 for one of the client's keywords). Scored in harness/scenarios_air_live1.js: precision and recall must be 100% on this set, and the old rule's misses are named.
